product.description:
Stories of the Great Operas and Their Composers — Ernest Newman

A substantial vintage opera reference combining Volumes I, II and III in one red hardcover, with decorative gilt spine lettering and ornament. Newman presents opera stories alongside discussion of their composers and music. Volume I covers Richard Wagner.

Condition

Acceptable vintage condition. No dust jacket. Red boards show rubbing, scuffs and marks; gilt decoration is worn. Corners and spine ends are worn, with a small area of cloth loss near the upper spine joint. Pages and endpapers show age toning and spotting. The photographed Volume I leaf has a small notch/tear at its outer edge. All three internal volumes are present, as confirmed by the owner; the book has not been inspected page by page, and binding strength and individual-page completeness have not been fully checked. Please review all eight photographs.

Details

  • Author: Ernest Newman
  • Full title: Stories of the Great Operas and Their Composers
  • Publisher: Garden City Publishing Co., Inc., New York
  • Copyrights 1928, 1929 and 1930 by Alfred A. Knopf, Inc.; this Garden City printing is undated
  • English-language red textured cloth hardcover; three internal volumes in one physical book
  • Approximately 8½ × 5⅞ × 3 inches; book-only weight 2 lb 8.6 oz

Included

One hardcover containing Volumes I, II and III. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
